title: Path sum exists
statementMd:
Return whether some root-to-leaf path has values adding up to `target`. The tree is given as a level-order list where `None` marks a missing child (like `[3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7]`); the helper `build_tree` in the solution shows how it is read, and in your function the argument is already that list.

**Example:** `has_path_sum([5, 4, 8, 11, null, 13, 4, 7, 2, null, null, null, 1], 22)` returns `true`.
hints: Subtract as you go down; check at leaves.
